levels.surface: أبو علي أحمد بن محمد الصولي
أمير المؤمنين علي بن أبي طالب

notes: The text opens «8 - قال: أخبرني» with the speaker not written as a transmitter, so the first link is Abu Nasr

Ali speaks inside Ibn Hanafiyya's story, so he is the last link (owner ruling 5); the man at the Ka'ba, whom the text identifies as al-Khidr, speaks the advice and is not linked by name: needs a ruling on whether he is the last link
«عن شيخ من أهل حضرموت» is an unnamed link (rule 8)
